unknown_objective_team_count.semantics: StateV2 (gameplay/state_value.py): count of events with timestamp <= query whose team is not 100/200 — ELITE_MONSTER_KILL with killerTeamId (or killer roster team) missing/other, DRAGON_SOUL_GIVEN with teamId not 100/200 (unassigned soul), BUILDING_KILL/TURRET_PLATE_DESTROYED with teamId not 100/200. It mixes neutral objectives, souls and structures, so it cannot be split without changing another input; retained verbatim.
